# zig-notify

> Cross-platform notification abstraction in Zig with C FFI -- macOS (osascript) and Linux (libnotify).

## API

4 exported C functions. Header: `include/zig_notify.h`.

- `int zig_notify_init(const char *app_name, size_t app_name_len)` -- Initialize notification system. Required on Linux before send. No-op on macOS. Returns 0 or -1.
- `int zig_notify_send(const char *title, size_t title_len, const char *body, size_t body_len, zig_notify_urgency_t urgency)` -- Send a notification. body may be NULL. Returns 0 or -1.
- `int zig_notify_request_permission(void)` -- Request permission (macOS UNUserNotificationCenter). Currently returns 0 on all platforms.
- `void zig_notify_deinit(void)` -- Clean up resources. Call on exit on Linux. No-op on macOS.

## Types

- `zig_notify_urgency_t` -- Enum: `ZIG_NOTIFY_URGENCY_LOW` (0), `ZIG_NOTIFY_URGENCY_NORMAL` (1), `ZIG_NOTIFY_URGENCY_CRITICAL` (2).

## Error Conventions

- `0` = success
- `-1` = failure
- `-2` = error (request_permission only)

## Integration

Add as git submodule:

```bash
git submodule add https://github.com/Jesssullivan/zig-notify.git vendor/notify
cd vendor/notify && zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast
```

Link (macOS): `-lzig-notify` (no frameworks; uses osascript binary)
Link (Linux): `-lzig-notify -lnotify -lglib-2.0 -lgobject-2.0`

Include: `#include "zig_notify.h"` (path: `vendor/notify/include/`).

## Source Files

- `src/ffi.zig` -- C FFI exports (init, send, request_permission, deinit)
- `src/notify.zig` -- Platform dispatch (comptime macOS/Linux selection)
- `src/notify_macos.zig` -- macOS backend (osascript `display notification`)
- `src/notify_linux.zig` -- Linux backend (libnotify GLib API)
- `include/zig_notify.h` -- C header with all function signatures and types
- `build.zig` -- Zig build system (static lib, tests)
